why_ai: Screen-based SaaS with sticky installed bases and certification rules, but AI-native EHRs threaten the product.
why_clarity: Clean-claim rate and time-to-document are the agreed numbers, fed back by remittances within weeks.
why_digital: Clinical and claims data in, software out, sold through enterprise sales with some on-site implementation.

why_ai: Denial prediction, appeal letters and remittance posting are well-posed supervised tasks AI handles.
why_clarity: Millions of claims with paid or denied outcomes returned by payers within weeks.
why_digital: Claims and remittance data in, predictions and filings out, sold as software.

why_ai: 42 CFR Part 2 segmentation carries legal hazard, so vendors must prove what was withheld.
why_clarity: Consent rules are defined, but correct segmentation is hard to verify until something leaks.
why_digital: Patient records in, segmented records and software out, sold to small practices remotely.

why_ai: The biopsy loop is a state machine software can track; specialty templates keep switching costs high.
why_clarity: Every specimen is either matched, reported and scheduled or left open, a checkable state.
why_digital: Specimen and pathology results in, tracked chart states out, sold to practice groups.

why_ai: Schema mapping against a target model is a well-posed problem with abundant vendor training data.
why_clarity: Migrations recur with a defined target schema, and post-go-live errors surface within weeks.
why_digital: Legacy databases in, converted records out, done remotely with SQL and tooling.

why_ai: HRSA reporting and 340B rules add compliance weight, but the reporting itself is derivable by software.
why_clarity: UDS reports, sliding-fee rules and 340B claims follow codified federal specifications.
why_digital: Encounter records in, federal reports and claims out, sold to health centers remotely.

why_ai: Routing and offline sync are software problems; the field setting slows AI-native substitution slightly.
why_clarity: A visit either reconciles with correct patient, place and time or it does not.
why_digital: Visits charted in homes, often on paper, flow into software sold to mobile groups.

why_ai: The device-to-code chain is almost entirely mechanical, so software can automate it end to end.
why_clarity: Each image is bound to eye, date and code or not, checked on every visit.
why_digital: Device images in, coded charts out, sold to ophthalmology groups.

why_ai: Detecting payer rule changes from remittances is a statistical task that replaces analysts reading bulletins.
why_clarity: Edits are confirmed or refuted by subsequent claim adjudications within days.
why_digital: Payer bulletins and remittance streams in, edit content out, sold digitally.

why_ai: Self-serve go-live with no consultant is exactly the low-touch software AI-native vendors can win.
why_clarity: Go-live, charting and billing success are checkable, repeated across many small buyers.
why_digital: Practice data in, software out, sold online to physician-owners.

why_ai: Specialty templates and device integrations make practices switch rarely, slowing AI-native displacement.
why_clarity: Structured evidence chains feed claims with clear outcomes, but differ by specialty.
why_digital: Clinical and device data in, specialty software out, sold to physician-owners.
